journal_lines: The stone rang like a bell when struck. Inside: violet. Still growing.
Hollow in the rock. The crystals were still forming. Took what was ready.
Geode. Cracked it open. Purple light from inside, better than expected.
The seam led to a hollow. The hollow was lined with crystal.
Struck the right spot on the first swing. The geode opened cleanly.
The crystals were still attached. Careful with the extraction.
A wall of amethyst, more than expected. Took what was portable.
The geode interior was large. The deposits were better than the exterior suggested.
Hollow section of the deepslate wall. The crystals inside were perfect.
The pickaxe found a seam that rang wrong. Right kind of wrong. Opened it.
Inside the geode: not just amethyst. Something else too.
The exterior looked like ordinary stone. It wasn't.
